blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to October 2026

Over the 13 months from October 2025 to October 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in South Surrey / White Rock peaked at 675 in October 2025 and bottomed at 449 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in May 2026 with 110. The reported sale price moved from $747,000 to $700,000, a change of −6.3%.

South Surrey and White Rock real estate market stats for October 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 561 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 81 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: The October report gave $700,000 for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock, against $700,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: The October report showed 19 days on market for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 33 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in South Surrey?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in South Surrey freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
